header.accountsDesc: Real-time multi-account quota monitoring and atomic session switching
header.providersDesc: Configure third-party providers and multi-model pools compatible with OpenAI Responses standard
header.schedulerDesc: Independent multi-account alarms and staggered window activation
header.settingsDesc: Configuration options, sandbox status, and application preferences

accounts.noActiveDesc: You can switch to an account from the pool below, or run codex login in terminal.
accounts.noOtherAccountsDesc: To add more accounts, log in to another account via Codex CLI. CodexQ will automatically capture and archive it.
accounts.emptyDesc: Please log in to at least one account using the official OpenAI Codex CLI.

scheduler.emptyDesc: Click the button above to add a trigger schedule for the selected account.
scheduler.intervalError: Alarms must be scheduled at least 5 hours apart to avoid window overlap.
scheduler.autoRolloverCardDesc: When this account's 5-hour quota recovers to full and weekly quota is available, automatically trigger a probe to wake up a new 5-hour quota window.
scheduler.autoRolloverMinWeeklyRemainingDesc: Auto-rollover halts when weekly remaining quota falls below this percentage (0 means trigger as long as quota remains; e.g. 10 reserves a 10% safety buffer).

trash.title: Trash (Soft-deleted Accounts)
trash.desc: Deleted accounts are safely archived here and can be restored or purged at any time.
trash.emptyDesc: No deleted accounts in the trash.

gateway.title: Local Protocol Gateway
gateway.desc: Translates Chat Completions upstreams through a loopback gateway; Codex only ever sees the standard protocol
gateway.enableDesc: When off, providers connect directly. The listener starts only while the active provider has a Chat model
gateway.portDesc: Binds 127.0.0.1 only. Applying restarts the listener and rewrites the address Codex uses
gateway.envOverride: The port comes from the CODEXQ_PROXY_PORT environment variable ({{port}}); changes here are ignored
gateway.occupiedHint: A stale CodexQ process or another program is holding the port. Pick another port, or end that process first
gateway.portRange: The port must be between 1 and 65535

refresh.title: Auto-Refresh & Background Polling
refresh.enableDesc: Periodically probe the official app-server for quota updates in the background
refresh.startupDesc: Automatically synchronize quotas in the background when the app launches
refresh.dynamicResetDesc: Automatically wake up to refresh at the exact quota reset moment (+10s buffer)
refresh.notifyRestoredDesc: Show native desktop notification when an account quota is fully restored
refresh.notifyUpdateDesc: Show a subtle toast notification each time periodic refresh completes

trigger.title: Global Trigger Settings
trigger.defaultModelDesc: Default model invoked for automated scheduled alarms or test triggers
trigger.presetModelsDesc: Click to quickly select, or click × to remove
trigger.addPresetPlaceholder: Type model name and press Enter to add...
trigger.promptDesc: Lightweight greeting message sent to activate the quota window
trigger.skipIfActiveDesc: Automatically skip scheduled alarms if the current 5-hour quota window is already active

dataProcess.title: Data & Process Management
dataProcess.restartCodexDesc: Terminate and restart running Codex desktop application and background services
dataProcess.resetAliasesDesc: Restore all account aliases to their default login emails

about.title: About CodexQ
about.desc: CodexQ is a high-performance, lightweight local multi-account Codex quota tracker and rapid session switcher built on Tauri cross-platform native architecture and pure Rust core.

alias.title: Edit Account Alias
alias.desc: Set a friendly alias for this account to easily distinguish between multiple profiles.
alias.hint: Leave blank and save to clear the custom alias.

remove.title: Move to Trash?
remove.desc: Account {{email}} will be deactivated and archived in Trash. You can restore it anytime.

resetAliases.title: Reset All Custom Aliases?
resetAliases.desc: This will clear custom aliases for all accounts and restore their default email or identifiers.

purge.title: Permanently Purge Account?
purge.desc: This will permanently delete profile {{email}} and all its credentials. This action cannot be undone.

emptyTrash.title: Empty Trash?
emptyTrash.desc: All archived accounts will be permanently destroyed. This cannot be undone.

toasts.aliasReset: All custom aliases have been reset
toasts.testTriggerSuccess: Test trigger completed! Quota window is now active.
toasts.testTriggerSkipped: Test trigger skipped: quota window is already active.
toasts.refreshPartialWithReauth: Quota refresh completed: some accounts require re-login
toasts.startupSync: Startup synchronization completed: latest quotas retrieved
toasts.jitSync: Quota reset time reached, completed precise full synchronization

addAccount.title: Add Account to Pool

addAccount.step3: Complete login in browser, then return and click 'Sync Now'.
addAccount.terminalLaunchedToast: Login terminal spawned. Please complete OAuth in your browser.
addAccount.fileSelectPrompt: Click or drag auth.json file here
addAccount.fileFormatsHint: Supports standard OpenAI Codex auth.json file
addAccount.fileSelectedHint: Credentials loaded. Click below to complete import.
addAccount.manualPathLabel: Or enter absolute path to auth.json:
addAccount.noFileSelected: Please select a file or enter a valid file path
addAccount.fileReadError: Failed to read the selected file

doctor.title: System Diagnostics (CodexQ Doctor)
doctor.subtitle: Real-time health check for CLI, sandboxing, SQLite storage, and auth network

providers.noOfficialAccounts: No official accounts saved yet to switch to
providers.subtitle: Connect any endpoint compatible with OpenAI Responses standard
providers.leaveBlankKey: Leave blank to keep existing key
providers.testHint: Test connection and auto-fetch available models
providers.clickToAddModel: Click tag to add to pool
providers.localGatewayOn: When enabled, models can choose Responses / Chat; all-Responses stays direct
providers.localGatewayOff: Off: all models use Responses directly
providers.gatewayPortGlobalHint: Global setting · change it in Settings
providers.wireApiChat: Chat Completions (auto-converted by the local gateway)
providers.wireApiHint: This declares the protocol the provider itself speaks, not the protocol Codex uses. Codex always speaks responses — picking Chat Completions routes the upstream through the CodexQ loopback gateway, which translates in both directions. If some models of this provider speak Responses and others only Chat Completions, override them per model in the list below.
providers.modelWireApiTitle: Upstream protocol for this model. Responses connects to the upstream directly; Chat Completions is translated by the local protocol gateway.
providers.wireApiChatBadgeTitle: This model only speaks Chat Completions; requests are translated by the local protocol gateway
providers.wireApiResponsesBadgeTitle: This model speaks Responses natively and connects to the upstream directly
providers.customConfigTomlHint: Injected into ~/.codex/config.toml when switched; leave blank to use auto-generated template.
providers.customAuthJsonHint: Written to ~/.codex/auth.json when switched; leave blank to use standard structure.
providers.fetchEmpty: No models found from upstream, add manually below
providers.activeModelHint: Select to set as active default model, can override context independently
providers.contextWindowMinHint: Min 256K clamp; inherited by models without individual override
providers.setAsDefault: Click to set as default active model
providers.clearedAllOverrides: Cleared all per-model overrides; all models now inherit default
providers.customModelCwPrompt: Set custom context window for {{model}} (e.g. 1m, 512k, leave blank to inherit):
providers.noModelsYet: No models added yet. Click 'Fetch Models' above or add below.
providers.addModelPlaceholder: Type model slug (e.g. step-5-preview, deepseek-chat) and hit Enter
providers.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete provider '{{name}}'?
providers.tryAnotherSearch: Try searching by a different name, URL, or model.
providers.reasoningEffortHint: Baseline levels include low, medium, and high. You can add max or other tiers as needed.
providers.customReasoningTierPrompt: Set custom reasoning effort levels for {{model}} (comma-separated, e.g. low,medium,high,max; leave blank to inherit):
